sentences.en: The pro-democracy movement in Hong Kong brought hundreds of thousands of people out into the streets in 2019.
sentences.zh: 2019年，香港的民主运动让成千上万的人走上了街头。

sentences.en: They demanded democracy and that China uphold the freedoms it had promised when it took back the British colony in the late 1990s.
sentences.zh: 他们要求民主，要求中国信守在20世纪90年代末收回这块英国殖民地时所作的自由承诺。

sentences.en: For the first time since Beijing imposed a new security law on Hong Kong, police have carried out dozens of arrests and used water cannon and tear gas against protesters.
sentences.zh: 自北京在香港实施新安全法以来，警方首次进行了数十次逮捕，并对示威者使用了水炮和催泪瓦斯。

sentences.en: China responded by arresting thousands of protesters, including the leaders of the movement.
sentences.zh: 中国对此作出的回应是逮捕了数千名抗议者，其中包括运动的领导人。

sentences.en: Like a man named Jimmy Lai.
sentences.zh: 比如一个叫黎智英的人。

sentences.en: For decades, Lai had used his wealth and his newspaper to campaign for democracy.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，黎智英一直利用他的财富和报纸为民主奔走呼号。

sentences.en: He was a constant thorn in the side of Beijing.
sentences.zh: 他一直是北京的眼中钉。

sentences.en: If I knew that I would end up like this in prison, would I have changed the way I run my life?
sentences.zh: 如果我知道自己最终会落得如此下场，身陷囹圄，我会改变我的人生轨迹吗？

sentences.en: And I realized that, no, I wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，不会，我不会改变。

sentences.en: We interviewed Lai on the show in 2020, just after he was arrested.
sentences.zh: 2020年，就在他被捕后不久，我们在节目中采访了黎智英。

sentences.en: Because I've never did anything before intentionally, just naturally.
sentences.zh: 因为我以前从未刻意做过什么，一切都是顺其自然。

sentences.en: So it must be my character.
sentences.zh: 所以这一定是我的性格使然。

sentences.en: Now, if it's my character, it's my destiny.
sentences.zh: 如果这是我的性格，那这就是我的命运。

sentences.en: It's my destiny.

sentences.en: It's God's grace and blessing.
sentences.zh: 这是上帝的恩典和祝福。

sentences.en: So I was all relief.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到如释重负。

sentences.en: He was later found guilty of national security crimes.
sentences.zh: 他后来被判犯有危害国家安全罪。

sentences.en: And earlier this month, after five years of waiting behind bars, Jimmy Lai was summoned for his sentencing hearing.
sentences.zh: 本月早些时候，在铁窗后等待了五年之后，黎智英被传唤参加量刑听证会。

sentences.en: And when he arrived at the courthouse, what became clear is that the movement he once helped lead had now become a shell of itself.
sentences.zh: 当他到达法院时，显而易见的是，他曾经帮助领导的那场运动如今已名存实亡。

sentences.en: A small group of pro-democracy demonstrators had gathered outside, their faces hidden by scarves and masks for fear of being identified.
sentences.zh: 一小群民主示威者聚集在外面，他们戴着围巾和口罩，遮住脸庞，生怕被认出来。

sentences.en: They, like Lai himself, were waiting to learn his sentence.
sentences.zh: 他们和黎智英本人一样，都在等待他的判决结果。

sentences.en: The heavy, very heavy sentence, you know, almost comically heavy sentence was expected.
sentences.zh: 大家都预料到会是一个沉重的、非常沉重的判决，甚至可以说是荒谬的沉重。

sentences.en: 20 years.
Yeah, 20 years.
sentences.zh: 是的，20年。

sentences.en: For his age, that's basically a life sentence.
sentences.zh: 以他的年纪来说，这基本上就是终身监禁了。

sentences.en: Jimmy Lai's son, Sebastian, was also waiting.
sentences.zh: 黎智英的儿子塞巴斯蒂安也在等待。

sentences.en: I mean, by the time he gets out, if he does, he'll be 98.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他能活着出来，那时他已经98岁了。

sentences.en: Given the health conditions that he's in, and given the conditions that he's been kept in,
sentences.zh: 考虑到他现在的健康状况，以及他被关押的环境，

sentences.en: I don't know if he could even serve one-tenth of that sentence.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否能服满这刑期的十分之一。

sentences.en: He spent years trying to free his father and learned the news of his sentence from thousands of miles away in Paris.
sentences.zh: 他多年来一直试图营救父亲，并在几千英里外的巴黎得知了判决结果。

sentences.en: His health has deteriorated massively over the last five years.
sentences.zh: 过去五年里，他的健康状况急剧恶化。

sentences.en: His nails are falling off.
sentences.zh: 他的指甲都在脱落。

sentences.en: He's got heart probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他有心脏病。

sentences.en: I mean, look, everybody knows someone around his age, late 70s, early 80s.
sentences.zh: 你看，每个人都认识一些七八十岁的老人。

sentences.en: And if you put a man of that age in a 60 square feet cell in solid confinement the whole time,
sentences.zh: 如果你把一个这个年纪的人关在60平方英尺的牢房里，一直单独监禁，

sentences.en: even if you did that for someone for 100 days, the likelihood of that person surviving is not high.
sentences.zh: 即使只关100天，这个人能活下来的可能性也不高。

sentences.en: And he's been in there for 1,800 days and more.
sentences.zh: 而他已经在里面待了1800多天了。

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: But there was a little moment that gave me some courage.

sentences.en: It was when the sentence was announced.
sentences.zh: 那是判决宣布的时候。

sentences.en: And a report from court said that he even managed to flash a smile, almost to tell his captors that he's still fighting.
sentences.zh: 据法庭报道，他甚至还挤出了一丝微笑，仿佛在告诉他的囚禁者，他仍在抗争。

sentences.en: That even though they've shackled his body, attempt to break it, they have not shackled his soul.
sentences.zh: 即使他们锁住了他的身体，试图摧毁它，他们也无法锁住他的灵魂。

sentences.en: And I think his spirit is only being made stronger by his persecution.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的精神反而因这场迫害而变得更加坚强。

sentences.zh: 他出生在中国大陆，在共产主义接管期间在贫困中长大。

sentences.en: Because this was a sweetness he had never known and a luxury he couldn't really even imagine that it prompted him eventually to flee to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 因为那是他从未尝过的甜蜜，也是他甚至无法想象的奢侈，这促使他最终逃往香港。

sentences.zh: 他还经常给我讲他第一次踏上香港时的故事。

sentences.en: And he had never seen so much food in his entire life.

sentences.en: So he broke down crying.
sentences.zh: 所以他当场痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: And he'd always say it's one of the best days of his life.
sentences.zh: 他总是说那是他一生中最美好的日子之一。

sentences.en: And it's only growing up that I realized how painful that period of his life would have been.

sentences.en: And it was one of those moments where I kind of knew what Dad did for work.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我似乎明白了父亲是做什么工作的。

sentences.en: I think it was one of those moments that made it very real for me.
sentences.zh: 我想那是让我感到一切变得非常真实的一刻。

sentences.en: And was journalism something that you wanted to do?
sentences.zh: 新闻业是你想要从事的职业吗？

sentences.en: Was owning a newspaper something that you wanted to do?
sentences.zh: 拥有一家报社是你想要做的事情吗？

sentences.en: This entire line of work that your dad is doing.
sentences.zh: 你父亲所从事的这一整行工作。

sentences.en: It wasn't something that I particularly wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我特别想做的事情。

sentences.en: And I think part of the reason is because he was very free in terms of how he wanted us to live our lives.
sentences.zh: 我想部分原因是，他在我们如何生活的问题上非常开明。

sentences.en: So he kind of freed you from that expectation to pursue what you wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以他让你摆脱了那种必须追求他所期望的束缚。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: He knew that this was his fight.
sentences.zh: 他知道这是他自己的抗争。

sentences.en: You know, especially there were occasions where he was followed, a house was firebombed, someone skinned a dog and pinned it on our door.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特别是有几次他被人跟踪，房子被投掷燃烧弹，有人剥了狗皮钉在我们的门上。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And so, you know, Dad knew that this wasn't a fight.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，父亲知道这并不是一场……

sentences.en: It wasn't a...
sentences.zh: 这并不是一场……

sentences.en: He would say himself that it wasn't necessarily a fight that he wanted to pass on to his kids because he knew the tremendous sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 他自己也说过，这不一定是他想传给孩子们的抗争，因为他知道这需要巨大的牺牲。

sentences.en: And in fact, I think that's what is so remarkable about him.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这正是他最了不起的地方。

sentences.en: This idea of someone arriving as a stowaway and becoming one of the most successful business people and then saying that I'm going to sacrifice
sentences.zh: 一个人作为偷渡客来到这里，成为最成功的商人之一，然后说我要牺牲

sentences.en: all that success, all of those opportunities
sentences.zh: 这一切成功，所有这些机会

sentences.en: to stand up for what is right.
sentences.zh: 去捍卫正确的事物。

sentences.en: And I still remember this moment.
sentences.zh: 我至今还记得那个时刻。

sentences.en: It's me, him and my mother.
sentences.zh: 当时是我、他和我的母亲。

sentences.en: We're in London walking through Hyde Park and it's a sunny day.
sentences.zh: 我们在伦敦逛海德公园，那天阳光明媚。

sentences.en: And my father was, you know, he learned how to sing.
sentences.zh: 我父亲，你知道，他学会了唱歌。

sentences.en: To be completely honest, he didn't sing that well.
sentences.zh: 老实说，他唱得并不好。

sentences.en: But he liked to sing and that's how you get better.
sentences.zh: 但他喜欢唱歌，而这就是进步的方式。

sentences.en: And on this beautiful day in London, he's just singing in the park.
sentences.zh: 在伦敦这个美丽的白天，他就在公园里唱歌。

sentences.en: What was he singing?
sentences.zh: 他唱的是什么？

sentences.en: He was singing Ave Maria.
sentences.zh: 他唱的是《圣母颂》。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A difficult song for anyone.
sentences.zh: 这对任何人来说都是一首很难的歌。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: That's very true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, thinking back on that day,
sentences.zh: 你知道，回想起那天，

sentences.en: just my father, you know, the sun shining on him, saying Ave Maria at the top of his lungs.
sentences.zh: 只有我的父亲，你知道，阳光照在他身上，声嘶力竭地唱着《圣母颂》。

sentences.en: Even at that age, I think I was maybe 14, 15, a thought came to me that it's what personal freedom looks like.
sentences.zh: 即使在那个年纪，我想我大概14、15岁吧，我脑子里闪过一个念头：这就是个人自由的样子。

sentences.en: You know, here's a man who loves life, who loves so many different elements of life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个热爱生活，热爱生活各个方面的人。

sentences.en: And when he escaped China, that was what he escaped for.
sentences.zh: 当他逃离中国时，他就是为了这个而逃出来的。

sentences.en: And it was a moment where I realized he had long achieved that.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我意识到，他早已实现了这一点。

sentences.en: That he had the wealth, the status,
sentences.zh: 他拥有了财富、地位，

sentences.en: the appreciation of someone that was free, of someone that was truly free.
sentences.zh: 拥有了作为一个自由人，一个真正自由的人所应有的赏识。

sentences.en: And had he stayed there, had he stayed in London, you know, he's a British citizen, he's got a British passport,
sentences.zh: 如果他留在那儿，如果他留在伦敦，你知道，他是英国公民，有英国护照，

sentences.en: he would have had personal freedom.
sentences.zh: 他本可以拥有个人自由。

sentences.en: But despite that said that, actually, I can't just be a person who lives for my own pleasure.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，他说，实际上，我不能只做一个为自己享乐而活的人。

sentences.en: And you were starting to understand that even as, it sounds like, a teenager.
sentences.zh: 听起来即使在你十几岁的时候，你就开始理解这一点了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That your dad was a man who could have lived, if he chose to, in a state of constant indulgence.
sentences.zh: 你父亲是一个如果他愿意，本可以一直过着不断享乐生活的人。

sentences.en: You know, his whole life could have been essentially walking through a very beautiful park, singing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的一生本可以基本上就是走在非常美丽的公园里，唱着歌。

sentences.en: And instead, he chose a very different life, with a great deal more risk and struggle.
sentences.zh: 但他却选择了另一种生活，伴随着巨大的风险和挣扎。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think he chose a life that, instead of a life that would have been outwardly beautiful, he chose one of inward beauty.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想他选择了一种生活，与其选择一种外表美丽的生活，他选择了一种内在美的生活。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: One that, you know, has landed him in the Hong Kong prison.
sentences.zh: 一种让他最终身陷香港监狱的生活。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: I'm curious if you anticipated at any point that the promises that China made about Hong Kong's freedoms, I wonder when you started to sense that those promises
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你是否在某个时刻预见到中国对香港自由所做的承诺，我想知道你什么时候开始感觉到这些承诺

sentences.en: were not going to be kept.
sentences.zh: 将无法兑现。

sentences.en: For me, at least, it was 2014 during the Umbrella protests.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，至少是在2014年的雨伞运动期间。

sentences.en: These are pro-democracy.
sentences.zh: 这些是支持民主的。

sentences.en: Exactly, pro-democracy protests.
sentences.zh: 没错，支持民主的抗议活动。

sentences.en: I was a university student at that point.
sentences.zh: 那时我还是个大学生。

sentences.en: And dad used to go out every day and join the proteSt.
sentences.zh: 父亲过去每天都会出去参加抗议活动。

sentences.en: He would stand up there with a microphone and give speeches and then tell people to stand up for this and do it peacefully and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 他会站在那里拿着麦克风发表演讲，然后告诉人们要为此挺身而出，和平地去做等等。

sentences.en: He was always a man of peace.
sentences.zh: 他一直是一个热爱和平的人。

sentences.en: But he was tear-gassed.
sentences.zh: 但他还是被催泪瓦斯袭击了。

sentences.en: Someone even shot a canister at him.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人向他发射了催泪弹罐。

sentences.en: And then there was once where they threw pig innings on him.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，他们向他泼了猪内脏。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And then once the tear gas came, he'd sort of, you know, wipe his face and then go back up again and talk again.
sentences.zh: 一旦催泪瓦斯袭来，他就会，你知道，擦擦脸，然后又站起来继续讲话。

sentences.en: As this is happening, are you out in the streets with your dad?
sentences.zh: 当这一切发生时，你也在街上和你父亲在一起吗？

sentences.en: Are you participating in those 2014 protests?
sentences.zh: 你参与了2014年的那些抗议活动吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was out on the streets, but I wasn't with dad.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在街上，但我没和父亲在一起。

sentences.en: But you were protesting?
sentences.zh: 但你在抗议？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was protesting, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在抗议，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I was also hit with tear canisters as well.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我也被催泪弹击中了。

sentences.en: And I still remember I was with my girlfriend and my wife at that time.
sentences.zh: 我还记得当时我和我的女朋友，也就是现在的妻子在一起。

sentences.en: And I just told her, like, look, just turn around and start walking.
sentences.zh: 我只是告诉她，听着，转过身开始走。

sentences.en: And then you feel a prickle at the back of your neck and then you breathe in and, you know, all the tear gas.
sentences.zh: 然后你感觉到脖子后面一阵刺痛，接着你吸了一口气，你知道，全是催泪瓦斯。

sentences.en: And so I still remember that.
sentences.zh: 所以我至今还记得那个场景。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, nothing compared to what dad was doing, which he was literally on the front lines.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，这和他所做的一切相比根本不算什么，他当时真的是在最前线。

sentences.en: Was he encouraging you to get involved in the protests?
sentences.zh: 他有没有鼓励你参与抗议活动？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I don't think it was something that he needed encouraging.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这需要他鼓励。

sentences.en: I think, you know, at that point we realized
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，在那一刻我们意识到

sentences.en: that we're fighting for these freedoms for our home and for our kids and their kids.
sentences.zh: 我们是在为我们的家园，为我们的孩子和他们的后代争取这些自由。

sentences.en: You felt like you were part of something that was bigger than yourself.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己是比个人更宏大事业的一部分。

sentences.en: Of course, after the 2014 protests, which died down for some period of time, by 2019, they are in full blossom once again.
sentences.zh: 当然，2014年的抗议活动平息了一段时间后，到了2019年，它们再次全面爆发。

sentences.en: People are out in the streets.
sentences.zh: 人们走上街头。

sentences.en: And those protests end up centering around this now infamous national security law that starts to take freedoms away in a pretty formal way.
sentences.zh: 而那些抗议活动最终围绕着现在臭名昭著的《国家安全法》，它开始以一种非常正式的方式剥夺自由。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine that in the back of your head in that period, you're starting to wonder what all this means for your father.
sentences.zh: 我不得不想象，在那段时期，你的脑海深处一定开始担心这对你父亲意味着什么。

sentences.en: What was for you the first sign that Chinese authorities might be coming for your dad?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，中国当局可能要对你父亲下手的第一个迹象是什么？

sentences.en: I think it was the brutality
sentences.zh: 我想是那种残暴行径，

sentences.en: by some of the police officers
sentences.zh: 来自一些警察的，

sentences.en: and the crackdowns on a lot of the protests.
sentences.zh: 以及对许多抗议活动的镇压。

sentences.en: The phrase I'll use is kind of overzealousness.
sentences.zh: 我会用的词是某种“过度热心”。

sentences.en: There was a kind of a social contract that was broken between the people of Hong Kong and the police at that point.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，香港人民与警察之间某种社会契约被打破了。

sentences.en: This was new?
sentences.zh: 这是新的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this was new.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是新的。

sentences.en: And then from there, obviously, the actual passing of the national security law.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，显然就是《国家安全法》的实际通过。

sentences.en: And obviously, many people told the dad to leave at that point because, I mean, everybody kind of knew that he was one of the main targets.
sentences.zh: 显然，当时很多人告诉父亲离开，因为，我是说，大家都知道他是主要目标之一。

sentences.en: That that law seemed to have his name written all over it.
sentences.zh: 那部法律似乎就是为他量身定做的。

sentences.en: And that it was kind of like, you know, almost tailor-made for him, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 可以说，它几乎是为他量身定做的。

sentences.en: Did you ever try to persuade your dad to lay low,
sentences.zh: 你有没有试过劝你父亲低调行事，

sentences.en: to perhaps stop what he was doing in this period?
sentences.zh: 或者在这期间停止他所做的事情？

sentences.en: I, I, I, honestly, I've thought about that a lot.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我，老实说，我考虑过很多次。

sentences.en: And I, I didn't, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 但我，我没有，我没有。

sentences.en: And I keep thinking about why I did not do it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想为什么我没有那样做。

sentences.en: Because even at that point, I knew that there was a possibility that I'd never see my father again if he stayed in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 因为即使在那个时候，我也知道如果他留在香港，我可能再也见不到他了。

sentences.en: I, I, I also knew that there's a few opportunities in life where you're,
sentences.zh: 我，我，我也知道，人生中很少有这样的机会，

sentences.en: where you're called, you know, almost by your principles to do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 当你被你的原则召唤去行正义之事时。

sentences.en: And,
sentences.zh: 而且，

sentences.en: obviously, everybody knows that leaving would have been for a much more comfortable choice.
sentences.zh: 显然，大家都知道离开会是一个舒服得多的选择。

sentences.en: But,
sentences.zh: 但是，

sentences.en: he knew that it was the wrong choice.
sentences.zh: 他知道那是错误的选择。

sentences.en: And, I just found I could see that he knew that it was the wrong choice.
sentences.zh: 而且，我发现我能看出他知道那是错误的选择。

sentences.en: He knew that he was a captain and that he needed to go down with the ship.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己是船长，他必须与船共存亡。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that by staying, he could almost act as a lightning rod for the persecution to come.
sentences.zh: 通过留下，他几乎可以充当即将到来的迫害的避雷针。

sentences.zh: 香港警方周一根据中国在该市实施的新《国家安全法》进行了迄今为止最高调的逮捕。

sentences.zh: 媒体大亨黎智英。

sentences.zh: 然后，

sentences.en: what you feared
sentences.zh: 你所担心的

sentences.en: happens.
sentences.zh: 发生了。

sentences.zh: 他被捕了。

sentences.en: Where were you when he was arrested?
sentences.zh: 他被捕时你在哪里？

sentences.en: So, I was actually, I was on a business trip in Taiwan and, if you remember, back in those days, there was quarantine.
sentences.zh: 当时我实际上在台湾出差，如果你还记得的话，那时候有隔离政策。

sentences.en: So, I was still in quarantine and someone knocks on my door at five in the morning and tells me that
sentences.zh: 所以我还在隔离中，凌晨五点有人敲我的门，告诉我

sentences.en: Dad had been arrested, that they sent dozens of national security police officers to our home to grab him and then perk-walk him through his own office.
sentences.zh: 父亲被捕了，他们派了数十名国安警察到我们家抓他，然后押着他在他自己的办公室里游街示众。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 老实说，这是一场相当精心策划的权力游戏，对吧？

sentences.zh: 我是说，他们把他从逮捕他的家中带到他的办公室，

sentences.en: to say something to the world.
sentences.zh: 是为了向世界传达某种信息。

sentences.zh: 为了向世界，也向他所有的记者们传达一些信息。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 我本以为我会回到香港，但他们开始逮捕其他人了，所以，是的，我知道那已经不安全了。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果说你当时明白，一旦回去，你自己也可能会被捕，这种推测是合理的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.zh: 你有没有哪怕一瞬间想过还是要回去？

sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道你父亲免除了你作为自由斗士的义务，

sentences.zh: 你知道，就是接手他事业的义务，但你有没有哪怕一瞬间想过，

sentences.en: I should go back?
sentences.zh: 我应该回去？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 有。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: When I first heard that he was arrested, I wanted to do what I can to free my father.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次听说他被捕时，我确实想尽我所能去救我父亲。

sentences.en: And it's heartbreaking.
sentences.zh: 那真的很令人心碎。

sentences.en: I don't mean to be provocative, but I am,
sentences.zh: 我无意冒犯，但我确实，

sentences.zh: 我很好奇，不回去是否会让你感到某种负罪感。

sentences.en: I actually, I,
sentences.zh: 其实，我，

sentences.en: I think that
sentences.zh: 我觉得

sentences.zh: 这个问题可能得等四五年后再来问我。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, I think some part of me obviously wants to see him more than anything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得我内心深处显然比任何人都更想见到他。

sentences.en: I haven't seen him in five years.
sentences.zh: 我已经五年没见过他了。

sentences.en: I haven't been able to tell him in person how much I miss him, how proud I am of him.
sentences.zh: 我还没能亲口告诉他我有多想念他，我有多为他感到骄傲。

sentences.en: But
sentences.zh: 但是，

sentences.en: what can I do for Hong Kong?
sentences.zh: 我能为香港做什么呢？

sentences.en: I'll feel powerless
sentences.zh: 如果只是通过这块

sentences.en: to kind of just see him through this
sentences.zh: 玻璃

sentences.en: glass

sentences.en: screen and talk to him on the phone
sentences.zh: 在电话里和他交谈，

sentences.zh: 如果他们甚至允许我这样做的话，我会感到无能为力。

sentences.en: going now and
